account:
Today has largely followed my appointment book: a market walk, lunch at home, an office accounts review, and now three o'clock tea with the neighbour at the east-bank dockside cottage. The treasury held 128 emeralds, and the secretary reported no urgent business. My neighbour says they spent the morning catching up with neighbours, but has not yet shared any specific news.

What seems unusual is the activity around the baker, builder, and freight. Several townsfolk repeatedly reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of bread at the inn and elsewhere around the plaza. I personally saw the baker put bread into the bakery stall chest, which is ordinary business; the reports about the inn may simply repeat the same sighting rather than establish several deliveries. I also heard the builder ask freight to go to the inn for a private conversation about their committee's supplies. I do not know what committee this is, what supplies they need, or whether the bread is connected.

The builder invited me to inspect the great hall lighting tomorrow at precisely 18:00, and I accepted; the secretary has recorded it. Taken together, a committee discussing supplies, bread moving through the inn, and a planned hall inspection could concern preparations for a gathering or town event. That is only a possibility, not something I have confirmed. I have a feeling some organizing is happening without my knowing the details, but no evidence yet of wrongdoing or of any connection between all these activities.
